record.paper_title: Open Questions in Charm Decays Deserving an Answer
record.original_question: What are the inclusive semileptonic branching ratios, total semileptonic widths, and lepton-energy spectra of D_s, Lambda_c, and preferably Xi_c hadrons, measured accurately enough—at least at the 5% level for the widths—to compare semileptonic and nonleptonic decay rates, quantify weak annihilation, and calibrate heavy-flavor decay dynamics?

evidence.quote: BR(Ds → lX) has not been measured yet (only constrained), nor have BR(Ξ0,+ c → lX); I also remain unconvinced that BR(Λc → lX) has truly been measured.

The semileptonic widths of D, Ds, Λc and preferably Ξc should be measured with at least 5% accuracy. Comparing them with each other and the corresponding non-leptonic widths will illuminate the impact of WA.

artifact.status_search_result: Significant experimental progress has been made since the question was posed. BESIII has measured the absolute inclusive semileptonic branching fraction of Λ_c^+ (latest value (4.06 ± 0.10 ± 0.09)% in 2023, improving the 2018 measurement (3.95 ± 0.34 ± 0.09)%), and B(D_s → e X) has been measured by CLEO-c at the few-percent level ((6.52 ± 0.39 ± 0.15)%). However, inclusive semileptonic widths and lepton-energy spectra of Ξ_c^0 and Ξ_c^+ have not been measured at the 5% level; only exclusive Ξ_c semileptonic modes (e.g. Ξ_c^0 → Ξ^- ℓ^+ ν) have recent measurements at Belle/Belle II. The full program in (a)–(c) is therefore only partially completed.

status_evidence.title: Improved measurement of the absolute branching fraction of inclusive semileptonic Λ_c^+ decay
status_evidence.claim: Λ_c inclusive semileptonic branching fraction now measured to ~3% precision.

status_evidence.title: Measurement of the Absolute Branching Fraction of the Inclusive Semileptonic Λ_c^+ Decay (BESIII 2018)
status_evidence.snippet: First absolute measurement of the inclusive semileptonic Λ_c branching fraction.
status_evidence.claim: B(Λ_c → ℓX) was first absolutely measured by BESIII in 2018, addressing the original concern.

status_evidence.title: Semileptonic Ξ_c baryon decays in the relativistic quark model
status_evidence.snippet: Absolute branching fractions of both neutral Ξ_c^0 and charged Ξ_c^+ baryons inclusive semileptonic decays were not measured.
status_evidence.claim: Inclusive Ξ_c semileptonic widths still lack the desired 5% precision.
